stemMarkdown: A boat covers 55 km downstream in 1.7188 hours and the same 55 km upstream in 3.4375 hours. Find the speed of the stream (in km/h). (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Downstream speed $= \dfrac{55}{1.7188} = 32.0000$ km/h and upstream speed $= \dfrac{55}{3.4375} = 16.0000$ km/h. The stream speed is half their difference: $8$ km/h.
